detailsSection: This Audio file contains training module of Microsoft Narrator, the built-in screen reader in Windows, and provides the foundation for using Microsoft Copilot throughout the training series. It explains why Narrator is used in the demonstrations, how it compares with other Windows screen readers, and how to configure settings such as voices, speech rate, and verbosity to suit your preferences.
